note: Gap fill, 10 Nov 2026: every new file from the prototype thread's list (art/requests/prototype-missing-art.md). frame = one frame's size in art px; origin = the anchor inside a frame; glow = a <name>_glow.png sits beside it; ADDITIVE in a note means draw it with additive blending at full alpha. warn_circle_r92.note: danger circle for a hit of radius 92 game px (art radius 46), drawn 1:1 so the hatch stays one pixel. 8 frames = how full: frame = int(t / delay * 7); frame 7 is the flash when it lands. Unshaded, under everyone. For another radius use the nearer file scaled by radius / 92
